name: Raspberry Pi Camera Module 2
mpn: RPI-CAM-V2 (board RPI-CAM-V2_1); NoIR variant: Camera Module 2 NoIR (same PCB, no IR-cut filter)
description: 8 MP Sony IMX219 CSI-2 camera board with fixed-focus lens; the NoIR variant uses the same board without the IR-cut filter.

specs.label: Lens
specs.value: 3.04 mm focal length, f/2.0, adjustable focus ~10 cm to ∞

specs.label: Interface
specs.value: MIPI CSI-2 via 15-pin 1 mm FPC (15 cm ribbon)

specs.label: Variants
specs.value: Standard (IR-cut) and NoIR (no IR filter); identical board

envelope.axes: x = along the connector edge (25 mm), y = away from the connector edge (23.862 mm, connector flush with that edge), z = depth; z is the 'around 25 × 24 × 9 mm' figure from the documentation table, the drawing gives no depth

features.label: Mounting holes
features.value: 4× Ø2.2 mm (M2). Centers 2 mm in from the two 23.862 mm edges (21 mm pitch along x) and at 2 mm and 14.5 mm from the edge opposite the connector (12.5 mm pitch along y; i.e. 9.362 mm from the connector edge)

features.label: Lens position
features.value: Lens center 12.5 mm from either 23.862 mm side (centered on x) and 9.462 mm from the connector edge

features.label: FPC connector
features.value: 20.8 mm long along the connector edge, 5.5 mm deep, outer face flush with the board edge

features.label: Depth
features.value: ≈9 mm overall ('around 25 × 24 × 9 mm'); not dimensioned on the drawing

amazon.title: Raspberry Pi Camera Module V2-8 Megapixel,1080p (RPI-CAM-V2)

amazon_noir.title: Raspberry Pi NoIR Camera Module V2 - 8MP 1080P30

notes: Raspberry Pi publishes only a 2D mechanical drawing and schematics for Camera Module 2 (PIP 'Design Files' category 1205); no STEP. The 25 × 23.862 mm outline and 21 × 12.5 mm hole pattern are the same as Camera Module 3 and the AI Camera, so the official Camera Module 3 STEP (pip-assets .../1207-design-files/documents/RP-008154-DS-1-camera-module-3-step.zip) gives an exact PCB/hole reference but not the CM2 optics. No trustworthy community STEP was found quickly; none recorded. The drawing does not dimension PCB thickness. Product page fetch via curl hits a Cloudflare check; WebFetch worked. Amazon ASINs verified by title only (seller not confirmed).
